$comment: Checks the runner adds to a lane for one deploy target only (lanes.py with_overlay). Same shape as a check in molds/<mold>/testing/<lane>/lane.json and validated against the same lane.schema.json; factory.py validate checks this file too.

checks.name: tool.python
checks.why: mold_v1-078: off Vercel the agent's sandbox is a KVM microVM the API starts itself as a non-root user. If /dev/kvm, the kvm group, the prewarmed templates or the microVM itself is broken, chat still answers and every tool call fails. This asks the deployed agent to run one python3 command and passes only when a tool result on the stream carries the computed line, which the prompt does not contain.

requires.else: This check talks to the deployed agent and this application has no address yet: python3 .claude/scripts/provision.py {app_id} --deploy-remote

No usable session: a tool call runs as a signed-in person. Sign in to the app yourself and re-run the lane with that browser's `workspace-google-token` in MOLD_V1_SESSION_TOKEN, or ask the factory to request a one-time emailed code, paste it into the chat, and it exchanges the code for a session for one run. Until then this check is `skipped` and so is the LANE: never `pass`.
